recurringPatterns.pattern: Rigid four-beat section template repeated ~120 times: site/date, what evidence shows, what it cannot show, generalizing close
instances: At Jericho, in the Jordan Valley, settlement architecture offers a different kind of clue...
At Varna, on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast, differences among the dead are visible...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Symmetrical epistemic hedge with 'by itself' or 'alone', several hundred times
instances: A city wall demonstrates the capacity to mobilize labor and materials; it does not measure how often inhabitants fought
Broadcasts helped make violence intelligible... They did not erase individual choice, nor did they by themselves create the institutions

recurringPatterns.pattern: Paired antithesis as the default closing figure
instances: Protection and extraction were connected parts of the same imperial arrangement.
Protection and intimidation could occupy neighboring spaces within the structure of rule.

recurringPatterns.pattern: End-of-chapter recap sections re-narrating cases already given
instances: These cases can be compared without being forced into one sequence. Talheim gives...
Taken together, these cases distinguish capacity from incentive, justification, and consequence.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Manufactured forward-pointing questions as seams between case modules
instances: The next question is how regional conditions... altered the opportunities for conflict
The next question follows from this uneven protection: when authority moved beyond the household...

summary: Serious, disciplined; built from ~120 near-identical modules; redundancy uncontrolled (sites re-introduced two or three times); no named interlocutor; needs aggressive compression and de-templating.
